text: Appeal of Order to Comply (November 3, 2021) for 45 Weir Crescent.

The Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Confirmed the appeal of the Order to Comply, dated November 3, 2021, for 45 Weir Crescent, Folder Number 21 233325 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to June 30, 2022, and further that the appellant board the windows and install fencing to secure and make the property safe, to the satisfaction of the Municipal Licensing and Standards Division by December 31, 2021.
